##### Project general facts

SeaRenity is an extraordinary waterfront villa on Palm Jumeirah, created as a private sanctuary where contemporary architecture meets the timeless beauty of the Arabian Gulf. Set on an expansive beachfront plot, this exclusive residence offers breathtaking panoramic views of the sea and the iconic Atlantis, creating an atmosphere of serenity, prestige, and complete privacy. Every aspect of the villa is designed to deliver an uncompromising luxury lifestyle, where elegant proportions, sophisticated design, and exceptional craftsmanship come together in perfect harmony.

The lifestyle at SeaRenity is defined by an exceptional collection of world-class amenities designed for both relaxation and entertaining. Residents can enjoy a private spa, gym, steam room, salon, cinema, wine cellar, and an elegant internal pool lounge, while a double-height lobby, lounge bar, and dramatic double-sided aquarium create unforgettable spaces for hosting guests. The rooftop elevates the experience even further with an infinity pool, sun deck, outdoor lounge, bar, DJ area, and beautifully appointed terraces, transforming the villa into a private resort overlooking the waters of Palm Jumeirah.

Inside, the residence offers six spacious bedrooms, including a magnificent master suite with a walk-in wardrobe, his-and-her bathrooms, and a private safe room. Formal and informal living and dining areas, a show kitchen, private office, and elevator are seamlessly integrated into a layout designed for both grand entertaining and comfortable everyday living. Finished to an exceptional standard with premium materials, exquisite craftsmanship, and fully furnished interiors, the villa also features a designer kitchen equipped with branded appliances, delivering a home that embodies elegance, exclusivity, and uncompromising luxury.

##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jumeirah is a luxurious community located on an artificial island that is shaped like a palm tree, with a trunk, fronds, and a crescent-shaped breakwater that surrounds the island.

The community is home to a variety of high-end residential properties, including apartments, villas, and townhouses, as well as some of the most luxurious hotels and resorts in Dubai. The community is known for its stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, its pristine beaches, and its world-class amenities.

In addition to residential properties and hotels, Palm Jumeirah is home to a range of retail and dining options, including the iconic Atlantis, The Palm resort, which features an array of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues. The island also boasts a range of recreational activities, including water sports, beach clubs, and golf courses.
